main_text.p: futiles quasdam juramentorum formulas à se ipso excogitatas, chirographis obsignassent: Quare ab omni functione ecclesiastica deponitur; ac excommunicandus censetur, nisi mature pœnitentiam professus fuerit, ac synodi judicio se submiserit.

Argathelienfi Episcopo crimini datum, præter communia collegarum vitia, quod in illegitima quædam jamenta paftores adegiffet, ac librum liturgiæ obtrufiffet; Diem Dominicum profanaffet, atque ut tempori ferviret, heterodoxias Arminianorum, quas olim damnabat, publice defendiffet; Multorum animos qui hominem antea familiariter noverant, ingens subiit admiratio, quibus artibus factum, ut tam subito mutaretur, nam certissimis indiciis compertum fuit, eorum dogmatum quæ alibi strenue promoventur, nullum ipsi nunc displicere: Sed φιλοπμία δεινὸν κακὸν, vitiorum origo, tinea sanctitatis, excæcatrix cordium; quoisque nulla potuit movere luxuria, nulla subruere avaritia, mentis hæc ærugo Ambitio criminosos facit.
Infularum Episcopo nihil objectum præter communia Episcoporum crimina. Censura depositionis in utrumque decernitur:

Episcoporum agmen claudebant censuræ in Paftores quosdam, Episcoporum quorum libidini se mancipaverant, afflectas. Iohannes Matthius gravissima heterodoxias infamia jam pridem celebris, quam ex sinu Sinserfii Gallovidiani & Maxwellii Rollensis episcopi hauserat, tanquam sal infatuatus, ministerii functione deponitur: Probatum, eum publice tutatum fuisse omnes Arminianorum heterodoxias, ac preces pro mortuis, descensum localem animæ Christi ad inferos, damnationem infantum sine baptismo decedentium, baptismi opus operarum; se teneri missam Pontificiam celebrare si ita man-

page.notes: The page is a single column with no marginal notes. The last word "man-" is a line-end hyphenation that continues on the next page. Words in the Greek phrase are reproduced from the scan as best legible; the Greek line "φιλοπμία δεινὸν κακὸν" is a doubtful reading and should be checked against the original. Several letters in the body are faint (e.g. "Argathelienfi", "Infularum") and were read as printed. The word "amenta" in "quædam j amenta" is printed in black letter and marked as <bl>; "j" is probably a printed "i" of "insania" split by a damaged letter, and is left as printed. Possible printing errors ("afflectas", "Rollensis") are kept as printed.
